scope: Public, no-account sources that can regionally obtain height information for Busan, South Korea

localContext.warning: These sources are estimates or gridded summaries; they do not establish surveyed facade heights or whole-Busan twin accuracy.

candidates.release: 2023 Q4 global layer; repository documents initial public release 2025-11-12
candidates.coverage: Global, therefore includes Busan in the stated world layer; Busan tile intersection must still be checked against the tile index.
candidates.heightSemantics: COG band 2 is normalized predicted building height; multiply by 100 for metres. Band 1 is building-density fraction. NoData is -1.
candidates.access: GeoPackage tile index at https://opendata.aiforgood.ai/building-density/tile_index.gpkg exposes EPSG:3857 tile geometry and direct 2023q4 COG URLs. Query the index by bbox and read only intersecting COG windows/ranges.
candidates.license: CDLA Permissive 2.0 for dataset/COGs/index; attribution required. Repository code is MIT.
candidates.fit: Good for a bounded city-scale height prior aligned to existing footprints; not per-building surveyed height and 100 m cells blur adjacent buildings.
limitations: No Busan-specific 40 m time series; 40 m locations list excludes Busan.
ML estimates can be wrong; do not present as as-built measurement.

candidates.coverage: Global; catalogue describes the world raster and the GHSL download service supports geographic extraction.
candidates.heightSemantics: ANBH is Average Net Building Height in metres for built surfaces in each grid cell. AGBH is average gross built volume per surface unit, not metres.
candidates.access: Use the official GHSL download wizard/dataset package with Busan bbox, or the JRC FTP tile collection; select GHS-BUILT-H_ANBH_GLOBE_R2023A and clip the intersecting tile(s). Do not download the globe.
candidates.license: GHSL open and free data/methods policy as documented by JRC; retain citation and metadata.
candidates.fit: Best transparent regional prior when open policy and documented semantics matter; it is cell-average height, not a building-level attribute.
limitations: 100 m aggregation cannot resolve individual footprints reliably.
2018 source epoch is not current as-built evidence.

candidates.coverage: Aims at global coverage and says all countries/cities should be included, but warns areas may be absent or lack height attributes; Busan availability must be checked in the viewer/tile index.
candidates.resolution: Building-level height maps/tiles; exact tile resolution and per-feature uncertainty must be read from the selected tile metadata before use.
candidates.heightSemantics: Machine-learning-derived height product, linked to polygons/LoD1 through height_tif.geojson/height_zip.geojson; not a survey.
candidates.access: Use the release tile indexes to identify only tiles intersecting a Busan bbox, then download the required GBA.Height tile from mediaTUM. The README explicitly discourages WFS streaming/bulk extraction.
candidates.license: GBA.Height and GBA.Polygon/LoD1 are CC BY-NC 4.0; ODbL polygons are separate. Commons Clause/MIT applies to repository code. Commercial/production use needs a separate legal decision.
candidates.fit: Potentially closest to footprint-linked height, subject to confirming Busan tile presence and usable metadata.
limitations: Non-commercial restriction and mixed-license joins are material.

recommendedRecipe.purpose: Obtain a bounded Busan height prior without downloading a world raster
steps: Download only the small tile_index.gpkg index from the documented URL.
Transform the WGS84 bbox to EPSG:3857 and spatially query index.geometry for intersecting rows.
For each intersecting row, use its data_2023q4 URL as a COG and read only the bbox window via an HTTP range-capable COG reader; do not fetch unrelated tiles.
Convert band-2 values to metres by multiplying by 100, preserve NoData=-1, and record source URL, quarter, tile filename, bbox and pixel window.

Join the resulting 100 m prior to existing OSM footprints only as an explicitly estimated source field; retain OSM numeric height/levels as separate authorities and leave unresolved buildings unresolved when the raster is NoData or mixed-cell ambiguity is material.
recommendedRecipe.expectedOutput: A regional raster/lookup prior for review, not replacement of footprint geometry or proof of surveyed building heights.
recommendedRecipe.accessGap: The primary sources reviewed do not provide a verified, free, current, Busan-specific, building-level surveyed-height catalog. A native acceptance receipt still needs source-tile checks and a documented per-feature join policy.

claimsBoundary: No SOTA, accuracy, survey, current-inventory, or whole-Busan-digital-twin claim is supported by this packet.
